rows.notes_markdown: AI-assisted Windows x64 static recompilation for the PAL Wii release, replacing motion controls with conventional input. The Linux preset builds generated code only until the runtime is ported from Direct3D 11 and XAudio2. [Announcement](https://www.reddit.com/r/decomps/comments/1xbcihj/sonic_and_the_black_knight_recompiled/).
PAL (RMCP01). Additional matching-decompilation project with its own progress tracking. Requires user-supplied game files.

Reconstructs the N64 emulator bundled with Wii Virtual Console releases, rather than the N64 game code. Supports regional Super Mario 64, Mario Kart 64 and Ocarina of Time releases; primarily targets Japanese Ocarina of Time. Requires user-supplied WAD contents.
